Seed parses (5903 bytes); solution/app/seed/seed_data.json is byte-identical (sha256 b256f85e...), solve.sh copies it into /app as integration.md:5 asks, and server.js:29 reads it relative to __dirname with /assets fallback. Every seed fact the criteria assume holds: K-1 (1 May, 7-day M-11) expires leaving K-14 and held K-15; K-10 at exactly 7 days expires and K-11 one second later survives; K-17 'Insurer letter' held 3 May; K-2 earlier version 'Landlords notice recieved.'; K-16 literal <b>/<i>/<u> tags; K-3 'Survey booked for Friday.'; M-12 K-6 'Draft heads of terms' and K-5 'Fenwick'; M-13 30-day with K-13 'Probate ... 4,200' (version 2,400, 8d2h old so removed by 7 days), K-18 Harriet 'Costs estimate' 3 May (9 days), held K-7 executor, K-8/K-9 nested reply; Gwen sees M-11/M-13, Paul M-12. Frozen solution hashes match raw-evidence-index; golden-run.log (sha cc1b2523..., matches index) shows deleted_and_expired_messages, timer_changes, hold_scope_and_release, search_and_transcript and all other seed-dependent checks PASS. Adversarial: an app that ignores or hardcodes a different seed fails seed-dependent criteria; a conforming app storing the seed at /app/seed_data.json or reading /assets at runtime still works because /assets is a verifier artifact.
